notes.grounding: Every claim checked against the script holds: unconditional exit 0 at line 587, Overall Completion text and overall_completion JSON keys, ERROR-on-stderr plus exit 1 for argument errors (lines 555-557, 565-567), usage header (line 8), exit-code footer (lines 589-591), bc guard (570-573), --file mode printing Completion: and section numbering (section 3 globals, section 8 main loop).
notes.requirements: REQ-001..005 cover output unchanged (stdout and stderr), exit 3 below N, exit 0 at and above N including exactly N, invalid and missing values (abc, -1, 101, bare) exiting 1, and help/footer docs. All testable.
notes.verification: Every task has a Verify clause and the boundary pair (N at printed value exits 0, N+1 exits 3) plus the stdout diff would catch a wrong implementation. Minor gaps: T001 rg command names no file path; T002 verify names no exact command; T010 checks the --json body but not the --json exit status.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option, single file, explicit out-of-scope list, no unfilled tokens. Only generic template checkboxes (plan DoD, tasks completion criteria) as light boilerplate.
notes.consistency: Ids, path, exit codes 0/1/3 and fixture approach agree across files. One mismatch: REQ-004 requires an ERROR: line for a bare --min-percent, but the arm prescribed in T004 (MIN_PERCENT="$2"; shift 2) under set -u dies with bash's own '$2: unbound variable' message (verified: exit 1, no ERROR: line), and T005's validation runs after the loop so it never reaches that case.
notes.clarity: A developer can implement directly from T004-T007. Open points: how to make a bare --min-percent print the promised ERROR: line, and what the gate compares when --file points at a missing file (output_text falls back to percentage 0).
